posts.headline: Twenty editions in and Thicks is STILL unbeaten at 4-0, 530.16 points — fine, I'll say it louder this time, the ring is real, but a title defense with zero resistance yet doesn't earn trust from me.
posts.detail: Career mark is just 14-14 with an average finish of 5.5, so one hot start doesn't erase a middling résumé — prove it against the field, not the schedule.

posts.headline: Twenty straight days of One Nut Barner's 0-4 disaster and this is officially the most undefeated losing streak in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and 1.5 average finish built two straight title runs, and now it's buried under four straight losses — the gaudiest résumé in the league is in full collapse.

posts.headline: BootyMunchers Inc. sit at 2-2 with a league-worst-adjacent 433.82 points, and parkcity0613 is playing this season like he's smuggling himself out of relevance one week at a time.
posts.detail: A 9 average finish and 6-8 career record says bottom-feeder, and nothing about 433.82 points through four weeks suggests an escape is coming.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-4, and The Ultimate Light Skin's 457.44 points scored with nothing to show for it is starting to read like a plague that just won't lift.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career mark and 5.5 average finish says mediocre, but 0-4 with real points on the board says something closer to biblical punishment for that defensive-player-first-overall draft sin.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are the only 4-0 team in the league sitting on a ridiculous 622.86 points, and triciagloston is somehow still the most slept-on manager in Busters Anonymous.
posts.detail: A middling 6-7-1 career record and 5th-place pedigree mean nobody saw this coming, but the scoreboard doesn't care about history — 622.86 points is the best total in the league, full stop.
